def find_lexicographical_string(s, t):
    n = len(s)
    
    # Iterate from the end of the string to the beginning
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        # If we can increase the character at position i
        if s[i] < t[i]:
            # Find the smallest character greater than s[i] but less than t[i]
            new_char = chr(ord(s[i]) + 1)
            # Construct the new string
            result = s[:i] + new_char + 'a' * (n - i - 1)
            return result
    
    # If no such string can be found
    return "No such string"

print(find_lexicographical_string(s, t))
